svg.title: Pocket Lab Lite Security Architecture Poster
svg.desc: Static architecture security overlay showing trust zones, canonical flows, controls, assets, forbidden paths and modeled attack paths. Modeled flow — not live traffic. Motion is explanatory and never represents a live connection or active attack.
svg.text: Pocket Lab Lite Security Architecture Poster
Static model · canonical architecture overlay · promoted/sanitized evidence · human review required

g.aria-label: Control CTRL-API-CONTROL; FastAPI remains the frontend-facing control API.; control-observed

g.data-threats: Denial of Service|Elevation of Privilege|Information Disclosure|Repudiation|Spoofing|Tampering
g.data-stride: Denial of Service|Elevation of Privilege|Information Disclosure|Repudiation|Spoofing|Tampering
g.aria-label: Control CTRL-BROWSER-NATS; Frontend does not connect directly to NATS.; mitigation-source-derived

g.data-threats: Denial of Service|Elevation of Privilege|Information Disclosure|Repudiation|Spoofing|Tampering
g.data-stride: Denial of Service|Elevation of Privilege|Information Disclosure|Repudiation|Spoofing|Tampering
g.aria-label: Control CTRL-BROWSER-SHELL; Frontend does not execute shell commands.; mitigation-source-derived

g.data-threats: Denial of Service|Elevation of Privilege|Information Disclosure|Repudiation|Spoofing|Tampering
g.data-stride: Denial of Service|Elevation of Privilege|Information Disclosure|Repudiation|Spoofing|Tampering
g.aria-label: Control CTRL-ENTERPRISE-ROLE-FINAL-OWNER; Enterprise authorization resolves active memberships server-side, restricts governance changes to authorized roles, invalidates affected authorization/session state, audits changes, and refuses removal or demotion of the final active Owner.; mitigation-source-derived

g.data-threats: Denial of Service|Elevation of Privilege|Information Disclosure|Repudiation|Spoofing|Tampering
g.data-stride: Denial of Service|Elevation of Privilege|Information Disclosure|Repudiation|Spoofing|Tampering
g.aria-label: Control CTRL-EVIDENCE-SANITIZE; Runtime/scanner evidence is sanitized before canonical documentation ingestion.; control-observed

g.data-threats: Denial of Service|Elevation of Privilege|Information Disclosure|Repudiation|Spoofing|Tampering
g.data-stride: Denial of Service|Elevation of Privilege|Information Disclosure|Repudiation|Spoofing|Tampering
g.aria-label: Control CTRL-EXECUTION-OWNERS; Workers, agents and supervisors own execution and recovery.; control-observed

g.data-threats: Denial of Service|Elevation of Privilege|Information Disclosure|Repudiation|Spoofing|Tampering
g.data-stride: Denial of Service|Elevation of Privilege|Information Disclosure|Repudiation|Spoofing|Tampering
g.aria-label: Control CTRL-EXPLICIT-PROMOTION; Runtime and scanner evidence promotion is explicit; MkDocs does not capture or promote.; control-observed

g.data-threats: Denial of Service|Elevation of Privilege|Information Disclosure|Repudiation|Spoofing|Tampering
g.data-stride: Denial of Service|Elevation of Privilege|Information Disclosure|Repudiation|Spoofing|Tampering
g.aria-label: Control CTRL-HUMAN-SESSION-CSRF; Human browser writes require an authenticated local-owner session plus a separate same-site CSRF proof; session credentials remain HttpOnly and hash-only at rest.; mitigation-source-derived

g.data-threats: Denial of Service|Elevation of Privilege|Information Disclosure|Repudiation|Spoofing|Tampering
g.data-stride: Denial of Service|Elevation of Privilege|Information Disclosure|Repudiation|Spoofing|Tampering
g.aria-label: Control CTRL-INDEPENDENT-APPROVAL-CONTINUATION; Approval must come from a different currently eligible Owner/Admin with purpose-bound passkey step-up and exact action/target/revision binding; approval does not execute the action, and the initiator retry atomically consumes one continuation with replay refusal.; mitigation-source-derived

g.data-threats: Denial of Service|Elevation of Privilege|Information Disclosure|Repudiation|Spoofing|Tampering
g.data-stride: Denial of Service|Elevation of Privilege|Information Disclosure|Repudiation|Spoofing|Tampering
g.aria-label: Control CTRL-OPA-FAIL-CLOSED; FastAPI preserves hard domain invariants, then requires a valid loopback OPA allow decision for registered protected actions before NATS/worker execution; unavailable, timed-out, malformed, or unregistered decisions fail closed.; mitigation-source-derived

g.data-threats: Denial of Service|Elevation of Privilege|Information Disclosure|Repudiation|Spoofing|Tampering
g.data-stride: Denial of Service|Elevation of Privilege|Information Disclosure|Repudiation|Spoofing|Tampering
g.aria-label: Control CTRL-POLICY-REVISION-LIFECYCLE; Typed policy candidates produce deterministic immutable revisions and manifests; activation proves loopback OPA observed revision/readiness before durable convergence, with known-good rollback/quarantine and explicit recovery proof when state is uncertain.; mitigation-source-derived

g.data-threats: Denial of Service|Elevation of Privilege|Information Disclosure|Repudiation|Spoofing|Tampering
g.data-stride: Denial of Service|Elevation of Privilege|Information Disclosure|Repudiation|Spoofing|Tampering
g.aria-label: Control CTRL-SUPPLY-CHAIN; Pinned WSL2/CI tooling produces sanitized normalized SBOM/security evidence before docs consumption.; control-observed

g.data-threats: Denial of Service|Elevation of Privilege|Information Disclosure|Repudiation|Spoofing|Tampering
g.data-stride: Denial of Service|Elevation of Privilege|Information Disclosure|Repudiation|Spoofing|Tampering
g.aria-label: Control CTRL-TEMPORARY-EXCEPTION-SCOPE; Temporary exceptions are restricted to catalog.install and exact app/device/human/policy revision, reject wildcard/global scope, expire within at most 60 minutes and can be revoked; matching enforces active unexpired exact scope.; mitigation-source-derived

g.data-threats: Denial of Service|Elevation of Privilege|Information Disclosure|Repudiation|Spoofing|Tampering
g.data-stride: Denial of Service|Elevation of Privilege|Information Disclosure|Repudiation|Spoofing|Tampering
g.aria-label: Control CTRL-WEBAUTHN-ASSURANCE; WebAuthn ceremonies bind short-lived server-owned challenges to purpose, origin and RP ID; passkey assertions update signer counters and purpose-bound step-up expires independently of the browser session.; mitigation-source-derived
